title: Around You below the map: a Dispatch ticker, a stat row, events and forming circles side by side, and a prompt row to act

source.ref: Daniel's list of 30 design changes, 2026-10-19, item 4 (plan row LIVE-1017)

detail: Daniel's list item 4, 2026-10-19. The page under the map was a narrow Dispatch column beside a 288px rail with empty space to its right. It is now full width: a Dispatch ticker (components/nearby/dispatch-marquee.tsx, a Server Component on the existing .animate-marquee keyframe, paused on hover and focus, still under reduced motion), four tap-through stat tiles, Happening near you (Today and Tomorrow badges) beside Circles forming, the Dispatch stream in two columns, and a Host / Start / Join prompt row. Empty events, circles and Dispatches each offer an action. Not done here: a Circles-forming read scoped to the viewer's city and a new-members list (members stay a count, no names). The shared index header is LIVE-1012.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const p=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/nearby/page.tsx','utf8');const m=fs.readFileSync('components/nearby/dispatch-marquee.tsx','utf8');if(!p.includes('<DispatchMarquee'))bad.push('page does not render the ticker');if(/lg:w-72/.test(p))bad.push('narrow 288px rail is back');if(!m.includes('animate-marquee'))bad.push('ticker lost its marquee');if(!/aria-hidden=\{hidden/.test(m))bad.push('duplicate loop is not aria-hidden');if(!m.includes('animation-play-state:paused'))bad.push('ticker cannot pause');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1017: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the page stops rendering the ticker, the narrow rail returns, or the ticker loses its pause or its aria-hidden second copy.
